newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: FORECAST - Bank/Portugal seen leaving rates steady.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Bank/Portugal seen leaving rates steady.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal was expected to leave its money market rates unchanged on Tuesday when it announces conditions for the next commercial bank reserve period, according to a Reuter poll of analysts.

All nine analysts polled said that while technically, there was room for the bank to reduce rates, it would not move because of lingering inflation concerns and the escudo's recent volatility. The announcement will be made around 1415 GMT.
The repo rate stands at 6.50 percent, while the bank's drain rate, the rate at which it absorbs market funds, is 6.20 percent.
The analysts were asked the following questions:
1. Will the bnk cut the repo this week?
3. Will it cut the drain rate this week?
5. Is there room for a rate cut whatever the bank decides?

The poll included analysts from the following banks and brokerages: IMF-Informacao de Mercados Financeiros, Siemca-Sociedade Mediadora de Capitais, Banco Portugues de Investimento, Banco de Comercio e Industria, Banco Finantia, Banco Mello Investimentos, Fincor, Banco Essi.
One bank declined to be identified.
